adaptationNotes: Copied terminal rendering helper behavior with local ANSI stripping, width calculation, fuzzy filtering, rows, headers, footers, and Brainstorming Pro workflow naming.
productBoundaryNotes: Rendering helpers are read-only display utilities and do not introduce upstream product types, commands, intercom, or workflow mutation.

adaptationNotes: Copied small formatting functions and removed upstream Usage, SingleResult, ChainStep, and chain product dependencies; exports use Brainstorming Pro workflow terminology.
productBoundaryNotes: Provides formatting only for workflow usage, paths, durations, and step summaries; no generic subagent command or orchestration API is exposed.

adaptationNotes: Copied atomic JSON write pattern into async Brainstorming Pro helper with JSON parse wrapper; not yet integrated into runtime artifact layout.
productBoundaryNotes: Helper only performs atomic JSON read/write and cannot approve gates, transition workflow phases, or alter topic/path validation.

adaptationNotes: JSONL append helper may be copied for workflow event persistence if ordering and error semantics are locally tested.
productBoundaryNotes: Append helper must only write approved workflow event streams and must not become an alternate source of workflow truth.

adaptationNotes: File coalescing utility may be copied for local write batching only after tests prove failure isolation.
productBoundaryNotes: Coalescing must not hide failed gate decisions, corrupt state, or reorder workflow-visible artifacts.

adaptationNotes: Rendering structure may inform a Brainstorming Pro workflow widget using WorkflowLiveSnapshot terminology.
productBoundaryNotes: TUI rendering must be read-only and must never approve gates, transition phases, or expose generic subagent orchestration.

adaptationNotes: Live state concepts may be adapted into workflow snapshots derived from state.json, events.jsonl, and in-memory progress.
productBoundaryNotes: Snapshots are presentation data only and must not serve as authoritative workflow state or mutate approval decisions.

adaptationNotes: Status text formatting may be adapted for markdown/plain text workflow summaries and non-TUI fallback.
productBoundaryNotes: Status output must describe Brainstorming Pro phases and reviewer progress, not generic pi-subagents modes.

adaptationNotes: Pi argument construction may be adapted later for workflow-owned agent and reviewer runs.
productBoundaryNotes: Launcher must preserve single-executable PI_COMMAND handling, provider-qualified model validation, --no-session, --no-skills, child marker, and depth guard.

adaptationNotes: Subprocess spawn patterns may be adapted later for foreground workflow-owned child execution.
productBoundaryNotes: Spawn code must not parse shell commands, register child workflow commands, or enable background async runner semantics.

adaptationNotes: Output capture and truncation ideas may be adapted for AgentRun and ReviewerRun artifacts.
productBoundaryNotes: Output handling must remain tied to workflow artifacts and cannot expose generic single/parallel/chain/async APIs.

adaptationNotes: Artifact helper ideas may be adapted only if they preserve existing specs/<topic>/.workflow layout and checksums.
productBoundaryNotes: Artifact helpers must not weaken path traversal guards, review binding, approval gates, or versioned artifact references.

adaptationNotes: Extension lifecycle patterns may be read for context but the upstream command/product registration model is not imported.
productBoundaryNotes: Brainstorming Pro must keep its workflow-owned /brainstorm-pro command surface and must not register a public subagent command or tool.

adaptationNotes: Background async runner modules are out of scope for this reuse spec.
productBoundaryNotes: Background jobs and async runner commands require a separate design/spec before any implementation.

adaptationNotes: Intercom modules are product semantics and are not reused.
productBoundaryNotes: No intercom runtime modules, commands, or public APIs may be introduced by this infrastructure reuse work.

adaptationNotes: Upstream builtin agent definitions are user-visible product content and are not reused.
productBoundaryNotes: Brainstorming Pro must not copy pi-subagents builtin role files as user-visible agents.
